text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we live, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias—if AI is trained on data that contains human prejudices, it can make unfair decisions, such as rejecting job applicants based on race or gender. Fairness means checking these systems carefully so they treat everyone equally. Privacy is another issue, as AI often collects huge amounts of personal data. Transparency requires that companies explain how their algorithms work, so people understand why a decision is made. Finally, responsible AI development means involving ethicists and the public from the start, not just engineers. When we prioritize these values, we build trust and ensure technology serves everyone safely.
